project.name: Numou Commerce - Aggregator
project.description:
Phase 2 commerce channel applications (Docs/Plan/base01.md Phase 2, §2.18 "POS becomes an application, not a domain").
The reusable commerce primitives - product, catalog, pricing, order, fulfilment - live in their own modules under product/. What sits here is the point-of-sale and kiosk *application* that wires those primitives to a physical checkout surface.
